package.name: Workshop Parts
package.description: Standard parts made to size: Gridfinity bins and baseplates, project boxes with lids, enclosures round a circuit board. Its own workbench (Workshop Parts) with a button and a task panel for each; a Python API (workshop_parts.api); tools for agents through Agent Link for FreeCAD when it is installed. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the FreeCAD project or the FPA.

workbench.name: Workshop Parts
workbench.description: Gridfinity bins and baseplates, project boxes and board enclosures, each made to size from a task panel.
